newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-HEAT BEATS KNICKS TO BRING SERIES TO 3-2.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-HEAT BEATS KNICKS TO BRING SERIES TO 3-2.

text.p: Voshon Lenard scored 12 of his 21 points in the third quarter as the Miami Heat literally brawled their way to a 96-81 victory over the New York Knicks in their Eastern Conference semifinal series on Wednesday.
The Heat overcame another poor performance by Alonzo Mourning and trail 3-2 in the best-of-seven series.

One of the ugliest playoff games in memory was capped by a brawl between the bitter rivals. Four players were ejected, including three Knicks, who left under a shower of debris from the Miami Arena crowd.
Game Six is Friday in New York as Miami tries to become just the sixth team in NBA history to overcome a 3-1 deficit.
The winner faces Chicago in the conference finals.

Miami's P.J. Brown scored 18 points before he was ejected with 1:53 remaining. Brown flipped Knicks guard Charlie Ward out of bounds, bringing players from both teams onto the court. There was plenty of shoving before order was restored.
After a terrible first half by both teams, the Heat snapped out of their offensive funk with a big third quarter behind Lenard, who was 5-of-5 from the field in the period.
